title: Recreational Cannabis in New Jersey: Know Before You Go

description: NJ adult-use cannabis rules with official sources: who can buy, ID, purchase limits, possession, where to consume, taxes, delivery, driving and travel.
lede: Legal cannabis comes with a few house rules, and the state writes them. Here is New Jersey's adult-use rulebook in plain language, every legal point linked to its official source, plus Lady L's own answers where they help.

sections.heading: Where you can and can't consume

blocks.html: Buying legally is step one. Where you enjoy it is step two:
On consumption areas:
At Lady L: “It's your responsibility to consume only in legal locations. Lady L does not provide on-site consumption space.” (Lady L's FAQ)
And at work:
Here is how Lady L's FAQ explains the taxes on an adult-use purchase:

“Adult-use cannabis purchases in New Jersey are subject to a 6.625% state sales tax, a 2% municipal transfer or user tax where applicable, and a $2.50 per ounce Social Equity Excise Fee (SEEF). These taxes are applied at checkout.”

Lady L can bring the shop to your door or have your order waiting at the counter. From Lady L's FAQ: “We offer delivery to customers throughout Jersey City and across a broad area of northern New Jersey.” And at the door: “A valid government-issued ID is required upon delivery.”

Zones, minimums, hours and account details are on Lady L's delivery page. Prefer to pick up? Lady L's FAQ says: “Yes, we absolutely recommend you browse our menu and place an order before coming by.” The in-store pickup page has the steps.
